module: Determines in which groups (grid sections) a vehicle config appears according to the selector's "Group by" mode: Type, Brand, Country, Config Type, Derby Class, Body Style, Source, as well as Years (by decade) and Value (by price range). Also adds the special Favorites and Recents groups. Used by ui_vehicleSelector_tiles.
notes: A group is a table {groupName, groupOrder}; groupOrder -1 = Favorites, -2 = Recents, 999 = "Other". For Type, the order comes from typeOrder (Car and Truck share "Cars and trucks").
A config can be in several groups: Years gives one entry per decade covered, and Favorites/Recents are added to the normal groups (unless showFavouritesMode or showRecentMode is 'hidden').
getGroupsForConfig calls groupModeFunctions[groupMode] (or groupsForRange) without checking: an unknown group mode causes an error.

groupModeFunctions.desc: Functions (value) -> groupName, groupOrder for the non-range-based modes: Type, Brand, Country, Config Type, Derby Class, Body Style, Source.

isRange.desc: Range grouping modes: Years and Value.

getConfigOrModelPropValue.desc: Reads a property on the config, or failing that on the model (core_vehicles.getModel).

getGroupsForConfig.desc: Returns the list of groups of a config for a grouping mode, with the Favorites and Recents groups if applicable. A missing value is classified under "Other".

isRangeGroupMode.desc: Returns whether the mode is range grouping (Years, Value).

getGroupModeFunction.desc: Returns the grouping function of a non-range-based mode.

getRangeGroupingFunction.desc: Returns the function that splits a value into groups for Years or Value.
